input.title: Predict how people react to a piece of news
input.lead: Paste a news story or announcement, say what you want to predict, and press Start once. MiroFish builds the roles, simulates the social media reaction, and tells you how far each conclusion can be trusted.
input.documentPlaceholder: Paste the news, announcement or event
input.requirementPlaceholder: e.g. how users react to the price rise, and which groups oppose it most
input.confirmRoles: Let me confirm the roles after the graph is built
input.seedsHint: Seeds share one preparation and run in parallel; the result shows whether they agree. More seeds are more reliable and take longer.

progress.interrupted: The backend restarted and interrupted this run
progress.resumeHint: Fix the cause, then press Resume; finished stages are not run again.

roles.title: Confirm the roles
roles.hint: These roles were found in the document. Untick the ones you do not want and fix names; preparation and the simulation start after you confirm.

result.indistinct: The roles' stances cannot be told apart; the ranking means nothing
result.seedsConsistent: The seeds agree: the main camp and overall tendency can be used (trend and ranking still need local-llm).
result.consistencyFailed: Seed agreement could not be computed: {reason}
result.noMetrics: This report has no confidence metrics (the report mode is not metrics); the other results and the full report follow.
result.confirmHint: Run the same document and settings again in a heavier mode and compare the conclusions side by side. local-llm is the reference path of the evaluation, and the slowest.

history.title: Past simulations
history.showUnfinished: Also show failed and running ones

run.refreshFailed: Could not get the latest status ({reason}); trying again shortly.

compare.title: This run ({mode}) against the original conclusions
compare.note: Overall tendency agrees within 0.1; the trend by its sign; the roles by the most opposed one.
